Nautiloid.title: Don't rescue Us yet
Nautiloid.description: Must kill Int Dev upstairs first, else he goes hostile

Nautiloid.title: Prisoners
Nautiloid.description: Click middle button on console to free them.

Nautiloid.title: Go back and rescue "Us"
Nautiloid.description: - 1 extra XP for killing the Myrnath after Us is extracted. Switch out to other char while in dialogue.

Crash Site.title: Disguise Self as Gith immediately upon landing
Crash Site.description: - Need Disguise Self. DO NOT go to camp (sh will vanish)

Crash Site.title: Recruit Shadowheart while disguised as Gith
Crash Site.description: - 30 for recruiting + 30 extra EXP if this is done as Gith.

Crash Site.title: DO NOT go near crashed ship before recruiting SH!
Crash Site.description: Only 2 IDs will spawn if no SH.

Crash Site.title: Kill dying mindflayer from range
Crash Site.description:
- DUrge: To Sleep, Perchance to Dream...
In crashed mindflayer ship. Do not initiate conversation; more XP this way.

Crash Site.title: Recruit Gale
Crash Site.description: - DUrge: Subdue Thine Appetites - Choose "Resist the urge and pull him out", STR check

Crash Site.title: Lae'zel area: Persuade tieflings
Crash Site.description:
- Cancel Gith disguise
- Convince them that LaeZel is dangerous, then convince them to tell you about grove, for the 10xp.

Crash Site.title: Hidden harper stash - get pouch and release spiders
Enter Withers Tomb through CR20 door on Beach
Enter side room of Withers Tomb (+10xp)
Interact with locked door in side room (+5xp)
Withers Tomb inside: pick up book of dead gods
Crash Site.description: Pick up ONLY, do not open until ready

Crash Site.title: Unlock and read book of dead gods
Crash Site.description: - Delay to LV10 for Gale inspiration push

Crash Site.title: Withers Tomb inside: undead scribes
Crash Site.description:
Open withers door to trigger

warrior 10xp
scribe 5xp x4

Crash Site.title: 3x Soul Coins in Withers tomb
Crash Site.description:
- One in room with trapped sarcophagus
- One in room with Book of Dead Gods
- One in Withers coffin

Crash Site.title: Withers Tomb topside: Gimblebock
Crash Site.description: - Persuade them to leave, then attack in TB mode.

Crash Site.title: Persuade guy at Withers main entrance to let you in
Withers Tomb inside: dumb door guard
First goblin attack at Grove entrance
Crash Site.description:
- Don't let any good guys die
- Soldier: No One Left Behind (20xp)

Crash Site.title: Cult Siblings
Crash Site.description:
- Send them after Owlbear (70xp)
- Switch to TB mode as they are running, and attack them (Brynna 15 Andrick 15)
- DUrge: Reuniting Friends (25xp)
- Loot mindflayer parasite. In dialogue, don't resist it (+30 qxp)

Druid Grove.title: Talk to Zevlor, get Save the Refugees and Healer Nettie quests
Druid Grove.description: - Make sure to ask him about a healer for 10 more qxp

Druid Grove.title: Talk to Arka (she will move to Sazza)
Save Nadira from bugbear
Druid Grove.description: - Persuade for soul coin, may need to pass checks for the 35 qxp

Druid Grove.title: Read book about Withers Tomb near Aron (+15xp)
Finish business with Arron
Druid Grove.description: Ring of Flinging

Druid Grove.title: Guex sword practice
Druid Grove.description: - Soldier: To Arms (20xp)

Druid Grove.title: Drop Shadowheart from party, leave camp, go back, then re-add her
Druid Grove.description: - I dropped Shadowheart while interrogating Zorru to avoid disapproval, then re-added her afterwards. Somehow I got 30 qxp for a bread crumb this way. I am not sure about the precise timing or reliability of this.

Druid Grove.title: Finish business with Dammon
Druid Grove.description: - Has good shield, hand xbow +1's

Druid Grove.title: Finish business with Ethel in Druid Grove
Druid Grove.description:
- Only reliable source of early STR elixir
- Staff with +2 to saves is rather useful for some builds

Druid Grove.title: DO NOT tell Ethel about Parasite yet
Druid Grove.description: She will leave shortly after you do. Conclude business (buying potions etc) first.

Druid Grove.title: Speak with Animals + bored ox + haypile (+15xp)
Spot entrance behind Doni (+15xp)
Druid Grove.description: - Investigation check, must pass

Druid Grove.title: Recognize Mattis scam with Warlock or Wizard (+45xp)
Catch Mattis and Silfy stealing, be nice to Silfy (Perception check)
Druid Grove.description:
- You can't use the same character you used to recognize the scam.
- 15 xp for catching her. In some runs I think I was able to get an additional 10 but I don't know how.

Druid Grove.title: Meet Volo, buy ring
Druid Grove.description: Very important for builds.

Druid Grove.title: K/O Alfira
Druid Grove.description: - 2 extra XP for killing the squirrels

Druid Grove.title: DO NOT long rest except to complete DUrge event!
Druid Grove.description: See Woodlands section.

Druid Grove.title: Talk to Barth and Meli after Meli steals Barth's locket
Druid Grove.description:
- Be sure to tell Barth not to hit Meli.
- I have had this bug out and not get the full 25xp. Make sure you do. Using Intimidation seems to work more reliably.

Druid Grove.title: Get Steal Idol quest from Mol
Return Barth's locket (+15xp)
Druid Grove.description: Steal it back from Mol's stash underground, then give it to him.

Druid Grove.title: Get Amulet of Sylvanus
Druid Grove.description:
Move Flat rock near Ormn bear.

This item is pretty useless but it's here because of how hidden/easily missed it is.

Druid Grove.title: Report Arabella's rescue to her parents
Druid Grove.description: - Folk Hero: Snake Whisperer (20xp)

Druid Grove.title: DO NOT free Sazza yet
Druid Grove.description: We need to save Smythen in the Goblin Camp first.

Druid Grove.title: Save Myrkon from Harpies
Druid Grove.description:
- Harpy 20xp x4
- Folk Hero: Protector of the Small (20)

Druid Grove.title: Free Sazza
Druid Grove.description:
- Antagonize and K/O the tieflings guarding her
- Chat her up
- Unlock her cage
- 40 CXP for tiefs
- 15 QXP for offering to free her
- 15 QXP for letting her out

Druid Grove.title: Escort Sazza through tunnels, save Findal
Druid Grove.description:
Folk Hero: A Timely Rescue (20xp)
Save dying Findal with a healing potion/spell for Wyll insp + useful stuff later

Druid Grove.title: Report to Zevlor for Hellrider gloves
DO NOT talk to Mol yet
Read wall carvings in Sanctum, pass INT checks
Tell Nettie you have a parasite
Let Nettie poison you, attack in dialogue, then KO her
Druid Grove.description:
- Say "Just hurry up and cure me" then "nothing strange..."
- Attack and knock her out
- 30 QXP for getting poisoned

Druid Grove.title: Speak with Dead on Dissected Drow
Druid Grove.description: - Ask about tadpole and absolute

Druid Grove.title: Get rune from Rath, open Druid vault (+10xp)
Druid Grove.description: Either steal rune from Rath, or wait until after Halsin is saved.

Druid Grove.title: Shadow Druids
Druid Grove.description:
- Persuade Kagha to join your side (we will KO her later)
- KO all Druids but Kagha during the fight if possible (Findal in particular)
- 45 QXP for persuading Kagha
- Oladan 75cxp
- Findal 15cxp
- Silver 5cxp
- Marcoryl 20cxp
- Loic 20cxp
- Rath 40cxp
- Pinta 75cxp
- Wren 75cxp
- 15 QXP for finishing fight

Druid Grove.title: KO Kagha
Druid Grove.description:
- You can do this any time after the fight with the Shadow Druids.
- She has a necklace that's good for some dps builds

Druid Grove.title: KO Bosk and Aelar
Druid Grove.description:
- Bosk will disappear sometime between Kagha and Siege and you will lose his +10 XP. Best to KO him after Kagha.
- Aelar will aggro when attacking Bosk; in order to avoid aggroing the whole grove you will have to assassinate him from range quickly.

Druid Grove.title: Steal Idol of Sylvanus
Druid Grove.description: - Move it out of Druid LOS using Mage Hand and steal it while stealthed

Druid Grove.title: Give Idol to Mol for Ring of Protection
Steal Idol of Sylvanus back from Mol
Before starting siege, find Doni for Rikka (+35xp)
Druid Grove.description:
- You may need to use Minor Illusion to lure him
- Afterwards, Rikka moves to the bottom of town

Druid Grove.title: DO NOT trigger the Siege yet
The Goblin Siege
Druid Grove.description:
- Allow Ogre to throw barrels containing goblins before killing him
- KO Minthara
- Do not let Tieflings die
- DUrge: Morally Acceptable Massacre (50xp)
- Folk Hero: Guardian of the Forgotten (20xp)
- Minthara boots
- Creatures involved: Sapper Moke (15), Goblin Warlock (15), Sword Spider (40), Sword Spider (40), Sapper Dextor (15), Goblin Warrior (15), Ogre Brute (75), Sapper Gald (15), Warrior Jawn (15), Booyahg Benta (15), Bugbear (20), Goblin Booyagh (15), Goblin Warlock (15)

Druid Grove.title: Tell Ormn the bear that Halsin is free (+15xp)
Post-Siege Camp scene
Druid Grove.description: - I got 75 QXP here on this route. I believe if you do not fully exhaust Halsin's dialogue in the Worg Pens you may pick up some of that missed XP here.

Druid Grove.title: 4 extra goblins that appear in Druid Grove sanctum area after siege
KO all druids and bears in grove
Druid Grove.description:
- Check everywhere, I found one hiding up near Harpy area.
- Kagha is separate in case you KO her earlier/during the Shadow Druid fight. Aelar is part of an earlier task as well.
- Make sure to get Ormn and Tuffet.
- Kill Tuffet (not KO) for Camaraderie in Bloodthirst insp
- DUrge: Camaraderie in Bloodthirst (50xp)
- Creatures involved: Arron (20), Inwe (20), Tahan (20), Elwyn (20), Apikusis (1), Karrik (20), Mino (20), Tuffet (10), Ormn (10), Topaz (1), Maggran (20), Tusk (10), Jeorna (20)

Druid Grove.title: Full Grove looting, KO stragglers - Check all side areas!
Druid Grove.description: You can now pick up everything left on ground.

Woodlands.title: Do not cross bridge into Woodlands
Woodlands.description: Triggers DUrge event; don't do this until Alfira is K/O'd

Woodlands.title: Cross bridge into Woodlands, long rest for DUrge event (read description!)
Woodlands.description:
- Cross bridge towards abandoned village
- Long rest ONLY after you have crossed the bridge.

You will kill Quil and get your DUrge cloak. Alfira will live.

Woodlands.title: Owlbear encounter
Woodlands.description:
- Try to kill mate first, then mother
- If cub is stuck aggro, run away from combat
- Outlander: A Mother's Fury (25xp)

Mate 20xp Owlbear 20xp

Woodlands.title: Do not approach Swamp yet
Woodlands.description: Wait until you have done everything you need with her in the Grove and are ready to fight the Redcaps.

Woodlands.title: Get fooled by Ethel on way to swamp, KO brothers
Get Kagha quest breadcrumbs before doing Mephit area
Tell Ethel you're glad she got home safely (+60xp)
Don't enter Hag lair or go behind fireplace
Talk to Ethel with Hireling (move MC far away) and donate an eye (+100xp)
Avoid Underdark portals in Hag lair
Enter Hag Lair
Woodlands.description: - 120 for going behind fireplace, 20 more for going downstairs

Woodlands.title: The Hag (read description!)
Woodlands.description: - Leave a ranged character far out of combat so you can sneak in and kill the Hag while the party is in conversation obtaining the Hag Hair.

Woodlands.title: Finish Mayrina quest
Woodlands.description: - 20 after hag dies, 60 after raising connor and giving wand

Woodlands.title: Selune treasure box in Owlbear cave

Blighted Village.title: Disguise as Drow, resolve ambush peacefully
Blighted Village.description:
- 60 XXP for walking into town
- 70 XP for being a drow?
- 100 XP for something something something?
- Charlatan: Just Passing Through (25xp)

Blighted Village.title: E Gate guards (1x sharpeye 2x booyahg 2x tracker)
Ogres
Blighted Village.description:
- Offer them blood (DC20 persuasion) for dUrge XP
- DUrge: Creatures of Bloodlust (25xp)
- Enter TB mode QUICKLY after persuading them
- Kill them for loot (headband of intellect in particular)

Blighted Village.title: Windmill/Barcus (read description!)
Blighted Village.description:
- Disguise as Drow and the goblins will flee
- While they are fleeing, enter TB mode and attack
- Kill Fezzerk LAST, otherwise the others vanish for some reason
- Then free Barcus for Wyll insp
- Folk Hero: The Most Unfortunate Gnome (25xp)

- initial persuade 190qxp
- trackerx3 0 devout 20 devout 20 shrpeye 0 worgx2 0 fezzerk 50
- free barcus 45qxp

Blighted Village.title: Apothecary basement skeletons
Blighted Village.description:
- Make sure to let the skeletons free all the others from their coffins.
- Good opportunity to get Radiant damage for Panoply of Agony. Use a Holy Water on one of the skels.

Blighted Village.title: Read Shovel scroll
Blighted Village.description:
- Warlock, Wizard, or non-Storm Sorc
- Do not scribe the scroll, read it
- Give correct answers

Blighted Village.title: Get Shovel permanently
Blighted Village.description: Talk to her with valid character after walking past mirror.

Blighted Village.title: Use Knock on Thay before getting keygem (+75xp)
Read Highcliff's Blueprints in forge basement
Get Infernal Iron from forge basement
Spider lair: Phase Spider Matriarch
Blighted Village.description:
- Let her hatch ALL of her eggs. 3 sets of eggs. Each small spider gives 3 XP.
- 17XPx3 small spiders, 10XPx2 big spiders, 250XP boss

Blighted Village.title: Don't pick up Thay key gem yet
Get key gem for Necromancy of Thay
Read all apprentice journals found in spider lair
Jump into Underdark from bottom of spider lair (feather fall)
Drop Necromancy of Thay on ground and read it
Blighted Village.description:
- Difficult saving throws
- Adds speak with dead passive

Blighted Village.title: Destroy Necromancy of Thay with radiant damage
Blighted Village.description: Spawns 3 Shadows. Holy water doesnt work, use e.g. Guiding Bolt

Goblin Camp.title: Goblin Camp Outskirts XXP
Goblin Camp.description: Difficult to delay this one... 15 at level 3.

Goblin Camp.title: Talk your way into Goblin Camp
Send Sazza into the Fort (X -56 Y 364)
Get Volo's Guide to Goblins from Booyahg Piddle in dialogue
Get hidden treasures on temple battlements
Goblin Camp.description: No good items here, but they are somewhat hidden and so noted here.

Goblin Camp.title: Kiss Crusher feet for ring - DROP DROW DISGUISE (+15xp)
Kill Crusher outside camp on bridge
Conclude business with Grat the Trader
DO NOT kill any courtyard goblins yet
Outdoor Goblin Massacre (read description!)
Goblin Camp.description:
- Start combat with non-Durge character, by shooting a goblin other than Mirg
- Have DUrge use a Scroll of Fireball to kill 5+ goblins for Insp
- Avoid killing Mirg
- When Mirg is the only one remaining, run away from combat
- Goblins involved: Warlock Gurk (15), Brawler Rot (10), Tracker Puli (10), Tracker Kirz (10), Brawler Tiny (10), Tracker Tak (10), Devout Mezzka (15), Sharp Eye Breg (15), Bao-ek-nuk (20), Tracker Grikka (10), Krolla (10), Sharp-Eye Aggy (15), Warrior Sul (15), Tracker Klagga (10), Guard Gurgon (75), Grat the Trader (10)

Goblin Camp.title: Bribe Mirg, then poison booze
Goblin Camp.description:
- DUrge: Now it's a Party (25xp)
- Charlatan: Spiked (25xp)

Goblin Camp.title: Outdoor cleanup
Goblin Camp.description:
- Kill stray guards and any mobs still lingering after massacre. (For me: just Brawler Rancer, 10xp)
- Get the items in the secluded stashes. (decent shield)

Goblin Fort.title: Talk your way into the Goblin Fort (Drow)
Do not talk to Minthara yet
DO NOT trigger Dror Ragzlin seance
Do not enter Worg Pens yet
Rescue Smythen (+35xp)
Goblin Fort.description:
- Quickly run to his location
- Enter TB mode
- Apply Invisibility to him
- Walk towards exit door. He SHOULD run out the door while invisible triggering the inspiration and the XP
- Folk Hero: Saved by a Thread (25xp)

Goblin Fort.title: Kill ogre Polma in Gut's quarters
Torture, heal, then free Liam (Drop Drow disguise!)
Goblin Fort.description:
- Torture Liam: DUrge: Grabbing the Poker with Both Hands (+25xp)
- TB mode kill the 2 gobbos (listed below)
- Heal Liam (+30xp)
- Free Liam (+15xp), Folk Hero: Fate Worse Than Death (+25xp)

Goblin Fort.title: Talk to Gut, get branded, tell her about parasite
Ring of Poison Resistance
Goblin Fort.description: In coffin near worg pens. Easily missed.

Goblin Fort.title: Go to Worg Pens, massacre goblins, release Halsin from cell
Goblin Fort.description:
- Begin combat by killing Birka outside Halsin's cage. Otherwise he kills them during cutscene and you lose the XP.
- Enemies involved: Brawler Birka (20), Warrior Plig (20), Beastmaster Zurk (20), Butcher Vrak (20), Ferr (20), Tale (20)
- Clear Halsin's dialogue completely. This netted me 75 QXP. I think this can vary based on whether you have already heard about Moonrise Towers.
- Tell Halsin to wait here in the worg pens.
- Upon leaving the worg pens I received additional +15 QXP for learning about the Underdark. This one may be unreliable/difficult to trigger/based on event ordering...

Goblin Fort.title: Get tricked by Priestess Gut
Goblin Fort.description:
- Get tricked by Gut so you are imprisoned in her quarters. Struggle free of bonds so you arent rescued by rafael. (60 qxp)
- Bring your party in to rescue you
- Kill Gut (40 cxp)
- Loot parasite
- She drops a decent shield with save bonus.

Goblin Fort.title: Goblins guarding Maglubiyet priest
Goblin Fort.description:
- Brawler Gurd (20xp)
- Warrior Clack (20xp)
- Sharp-eye Zami (20xp)

Goblin Fort.title: Free Magubliet priest, then kill him
Goblins in NW corner
Goblin Fort.description:
- Tracker Nikk-Nuk (20xp)
- Warrior Plagg (20xp)
- Sharp-Eye Crub (20xp)

Goblin Fort.title: Release Spiders on Goblins (see description!)
Goblin Fort.description:
- Convince the spiders to attack the goblins
- Join the combat by assaulting Gribbo nonlethally (may need to shove her into proper position)
- This should create a situation where there are 5 neutral units
- Kill them all in one round for DUrge insp
- Once that is unlocked, kill everyone
- CXP is approximate based on number of goblins around when I did this
- Creatures involved: Smaller Giant Spider, Larger Giant Spider, Warlock Greez, Gribbo, Tracker Azak, Booyahg Shekt, Devout Muzul

Goblin Fort.title: Front door guards
Goblin Fort.description: You already got the XP for these guys for peaceful entry. Kill them anyway.

Goblin Fort.title: Kill any remaining goblins outside Ragzlin area
Set up Grove Siege with Minthara
Goblin Fort.description:
- Save Sazza in dialogue
- After Minthara walks out the front door, quickly enter TB and KO Razzik

Goblin Fort.title: Ragzlin fight
Goblin Fort.description: - Creatures involved: Ragzlin (75), Warlock Bolt (20), Booyahg Gnat (20), Sharp Eye Roo (20), Warrior Huk (20), Devout Cry (20), Narvass (1), Kagran (1)

Goblin Fort.title: Solve moon puzzle
Goblin Fort.description: You may want to delay this for later for abusing Gale insp

Goblin Fort.title: Go to Underdark via Selunite Temple
Goblin Fort.description:
- Either solve the moon puzzle or pull the hidden switch.
- 15 QXP for opening the door above
- 110 QXP for landing in the Selunite Temple

Goblin Fort.title: Meet Volo in camp, treat parasite, conclude vendor business
Goblin Fort.description: Folk Hero: The Bard with Nine Lives (25xp)

Goblin Fort.title: Get treasures hidden in roof/top entrance of fort
Goblin Fort.description: No good loot here but it's easy to miss these.

Rizzin Road.title: Harper skeletons under bridge
Rizzin Road.description: Click on skeleton. One shot. Save before and don't do until ready.

Rizzin Road.title: Kill paladins
Rizzin Road.description:
- Soldier: Warrior of the Hells (30xp)
Don't bring Karlach, she destroys the building

anders 75xp
trynn 40xp
cyrel 40xp

Rizzin Road.title: Gnolls and Hyenas
Rizzin Road.description:
- Allow all hyenas to transform

- Soldier: One for the Ages (25xp) (Survive a battle in which you kill 10 or more foes)
- Outlander: Cursebreaker (30xp)

- Creatures: newborn gnoll x4 (40ea), bloated hyena x3 (20ea), hyena (20), flesh gnawer (40), fang of yeenoghu (40), hunter x2 (40ea)

Rizzin Road.title: Flind + Gnolls
Rizzin Road.description: - Creatures involved: Gnoll Hunter (40), Gnoll Flesh Gnawer (40), Gnoll Hunter (40), Gnoll Hunter (40), Hyena (20), Hyena (20), Flind (75)

Rizzin Road.title: Discover hidden stash E of Waukeen (+25xp)
Rizzin Road.description:
- sometimes I don't get this, not sure what triggers it.
- Holding still and reading the book multiple times seems to help.

Rizzin Road.title: Use Mage Hand to drop Smokepowder Bomb on Flaming Fist
Kill Qudenos dragon near Gith (+250xp)
Rizzin Road.description: - This guy is almost impossible to kill on Honor Mode without barrelmancy. I just stacked every smokepowder barrel from act 1 on him.

Rizzin Road.title: Voss dialogue: recognize and resist Detect Thoughts, persuade after
K/O Voss, kill other Gith
Rizzin Road.description: - Creatures: Kith'rak Voss (400), Raider Chost (75), Raider Zastri (75), Gish For'Eth (75), Sarth Baretha (90)

Rizzin Road.title: Loot Elaborate Slate from Saarth Baretha, read it
Rizzin Road.description: - Possible XP if you havent learned of creche yet.

Waukeen's Rest.title: Interact with Flaming Fist at door whlie they are pushing it (+25xp)
Waukeen's Rest.description:
- Soldier: Chain of Command (30xp)
- 20 QXP for talking to them
- 20 QXP for crossing door into Inn

Waukeen's Rest.title: DO NOT LONG REST OR LEAVE WAUKEEN'S REST
Quickly enter TB and Kill all Fist
Waukeen's Rest.description:
- Warning: this encounter is hard below lv 5.
- Creatures involved: Gauntlet Yeva (90), Gauntlet Dain (90), Fist Recruit Pavel (40), Fist Recruit Ephren (40), Fist Recruit Tristan (40), Fist Recruit Ito (40), Fist Recruit Aelis (40)

Waukeen's Rest.title: Save Florrick, then KO her
Waukeen's Rest.description:
- 20 qxp for freeing her upstairs, 20 qxp for completion
- Folk Hero: Resccued from the Flames (30xp)
- Get spellsparker staff

Waukeen's Rest.title: Get Dowry, complete Dowry quest, ko Benryn
Speak with Dead on dead drow, ask about Moonrise
Waukeen's Rest.description: - This may or may not give XP. I think if you already know about it from Halsin, it doesn't. Not sure if routing this before Halsin makes a difference.

Waukeen's Rest.title: Talk your way into Zhent Hideout (READ DESCRIPTION)
Waukeen's Rest.description:
- The whole Zhent Hideout is REALLY easy to screw up/lose XP. Make a backup save.
- Use a generic persuade option.
- DO NOT TELL HER ABOUT THE DEAD ZHENTS YET
- Charlatan: The Importance of Networking (30xp)

Waukeen's Rest.title: Give Zhent chest to Zarys (READ DESCRIPTION)
Waukeen's Rest.description:
- First, accept the job. Do not give her the chest right away and DO NOT COMMENT ON THE EXPLOSIVES. (20qxp)
- Give her the chest. Before the dialogue ends, you will have one chance to open her merchant screen. Do so! (60qxp)
- Within the ensuing dialogue, buy out her inventory.
- DO NOT leave dialogue without clearing her inventory.

Waukeen's Rest.title: Deal with Oskar
Waukeen's Rest.description:
- Speak to Oskar first (20 qxp)
- Free him with Brem (persuade dc 20 to do it for free)
- Tell him he's free
- If you don't free him "properly" this quest can bug out when entering Shadowfell later.

Waukeen's Rest.title: Finish business with Brem
Waukeen's Rest.description: Make sure to get Titanstring Bow at least.

Waukeen's Rest.title: Kill Zarys, loot Zhent chest from body
Rear Zhentarim
Waukeen's Rest.description: - Creatures involved: Isbeth (20), Jarg (40), Vol (40), Indra (20), Karad (40), Istor (20)

Waukeen's Rest.title: Loot Smokepowder Barrels
Waukeen's Rest.description: - These are useful for killing Qudenos later on Honor Mode.

Underdark.title: Shatter Selunite Temple crystal - don't let it kill the minotaur
Underdark.description: Acolyte: Shatter the Moon (30xp)

Underdark.title: Loot Selunite Temple
Underdark.description: Armor for RadOrb builds

Underdark.title: Phalar Aluve (+25xp)
Underdark.description: Acolyte: Last Rites of the Dark Dancer (30xp)

Underdark.title: Don't go to Myconid Grotto yet
Jump up to Egg Nest right outside grotto and rob it
Underdark.description:
- Outlander: Clever Cuckoo (30xp)
No notable loot but easily missable

Underdark.title: Talk to Blurg and Omeluum, get quests
Conclude business with Blurg
Underdark.description:
- Melf staff
- psychic spark
- boots of genial striding
- cinder shoes
- sunwalkers gift

Underdark.title: Conclude business with Omeluum
Underdark.description:
- Boots of Stormy Clamour
- Get On Illithids for later Gale insp

Underdark.title: Conclude business with Derryth
Underdark.description:
- Caustic Band
- Amulet of Restoration
- various potions/elixirs

Underdark.title: Talk to Derryth, get quest to rescue Baelyn
Heal Thulla's poison, get her boots, get Rescue Gnomes quest (+25xp)
Talk to Spaw, get quest, choose Bard Song option (+20xp)
Go to Duergar beach, talk to Ghek, show him the boots
Fight Ghek + Duergar
Underdark.description:
- Let Ghek summon zombies for extra xp.
- 7 zombies, 3xp ea
lurgan 75 holvik 75 ghek 110 harmor 40

Underdark.title: Find carrion hole near beach, transform to Small race, reach in (+25xp)
Underdark.description:
- WIS Save
- Outlander: Nest Egg (30xp)

Underdark.title: Read all 3 Mad Wizard books
Underdark.description:
- Hook Horror wizard
- Spectator wizard
- Myconid Treasure Room

Underdark.title: Rescue Baelen

Meta.title: I understand the assignment
Meta.description:
- For a number of reasons, the best class for following this checklist is Bard. In addition to good sleight and high rizz, Dissonant Whispers is one of the only reliable early sources of Psychic damage for the Panoply of Agony inspiration.
- Only do tasks that are shown as available to you. Do not go off on your own or you may trigger unintended events early, breaking the route.
- When a task is marked "Delay" it means there is a reason to save it, usually because it gives XP or inspiration that could be utilized later.
- This is a Dark Urge playthrough. Other origins will require significant adjustments and will not get as much XP.
- This is a "good-aligned" playthrough. DUrge is done with minimal kills, we recruit Will, we save Last Light. Some of these things result in less XP than is strictly possible.
- Certain items that tend to be used in a lot of builds are marked "Gear". Vendors are marked "vendor" and each vendor has a warning task to finish your business with them before they are KO/Killed. Some hard to find or out of the way items are also marked with tasks. Other than that, looting stuff is up to you.
